name: Executive order of February 2, 1874 replacing the Mescalero Apache reservation of May 29, 1873
citation: Executive Order of February 2, 1874 (Royce, see area 643)
promises: Not a treaty. The President cancelled the order of May 29, 1873 and set apart a reserve at Fort Stanton in its place, running west to the summit of the Sierra Blanca and south to 33 degrees north latitude.
today: Royce records this reserve was cancelled and replaced by the executive order of October 20, 1875. The Indian Claims Commission dated the taking of Mescalero aboriginal land to May 29, 1873 (Docket 22-B), a finding carried by that record.
